name: highlighter
title: Highlighter
description: A hand-drawn highlight, underline, box or circle that animates around inline text.

props.name: action
props.description: The kind of annotation to draw.

props.name: iterations
props.description: How many times the annotation is drawn; more than 1 looks sketchier.

props.name: padding
props.description: Padding between the text and the annotation, in pixels.

props.name: multiline
props.description: Annotate each line of wrapped text separately.

props.name: isView
props.description: Wait until the text scrolls into view before drawing.
